title: Status changes are one item per process

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
`done`, `park` and `unpark` each take exactly one positional id, and `set` takes one id.
Marking five items done is five processes, each doing a full `store.load` — which reads
every slice file — plus a full index rewrite and a log append.

For a human that is merely slow. For an agent closing out a batch it is five chances to
fail halfway with no transaction boundary.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body: src/slicer/ops.py; src/slicer/cli.py; tests/test_batch.py; README.md; docs/getting-started.md; docs/agents.md.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: Batch commands, stdin and duplicate handling, JSON compatibility, prevalidation with unchanged memory/disk, custom statuses, history and slice synchronization, one mutation load/index save, and no-op status behavior are covered in tests/test_batch.py.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Accept multiple IDs for done, start, park, unpark, and set. A standalone '-' reads whitespace-separated IDs from stdin; empty input or mixing '-' with IDs is a usage error. Deduplicate in input order. Apply shared fields/notes to every item.

Validate all IDs and fields before mutating memory or disk. Batch ops load once for mutation, save the index once, synchronize/move slices, and retain per-item history and status no-op behavior. Preserve single-item ops interfaces. The existing command lock and optional render reload remain.

One explicit ID returns a JSON object. Multiple positional IDs or stdin return an array, including one unique result. Human output has one line per item.

**Not in this slice:** undo or rollback after disk failures.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: Five focused batch tests passed (parameterized across commands and input modes). Installed slicer batch/stdin smoke and render/check passed. Full suite: 460 tests, 456 passed, one optional legacy test skipped, three existing workspace-isolation failures tracked by S54. Diff review corrected stale agent documentation. git diff --check passed.

sections.body: Commit S16 code, tests, documentation, and generated roadmap state together; push to origin/main.
